```artifact
GUI Event Graphs Test Suite for U02_Alarms

1. Alarm Trigger for Low Pressure on Air Line
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate air line blockage
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger

2. Alarm Trigger for Low Pressure on O2 Line
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate O2 line blockage
   - Verify HIGH severity alarm trigger

3. Alarm Trigger for Inspiratory Pressure Drop
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate inspiratory pressure drop below -4cm H2O
   - Verify alarm trigger

4. Alarm Trigger for O2 Line Pressure Too High
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate O2 line pressure too high
   - Verify alarm trigger

5. Alarm Trigger for GUI Unresponsiveness
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate GUI unresponsiveness for 1/2 of apnea time
   - Verify controller alarm trigger

6. Overpressure Alarm Trigger
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate overpressure above 60 cmH2O
   - Verify alarm trigger

7. Controller Unresponsiveness Alarm Trigger
   - Start with normal system state
   - Simulate controller unresponsiveness for 1/2 of apnea time
   - Verify GUI alarm trigger

```
